parts_of_speech.name: adposition
parts_of_speech.function: Marks a noun phrase relation; includes prepositions and postpositions.

parts_of_speech.name: adverb
parts_of_speech.function: Modifies a verb, adjective, adverb, clause, or discourse relation.

parts_of_speech.name: auxiliary
parts_of_speech.function: Adds tense, aspect, mood, voice, or related grammatical information.

parts_of_speech.name: coordinating_conjunction
parts_of_speech.function: Joins units of equal syntactic status.

parts_of_speech.name: determiner
parts_of_speech.function: Marks reference, quantity, definiteness, or possession within a noun phrase.

parts_of_speech.name: interjection
parts_of_speech.function: Expresses reaction, greeting, or discourse signal with loose syntactic attachment.

parts_of_speech.name: common_noun
parts_of_speech.function: Names a class of entity, substance, event, state, or abstraction.

parts_of_speech.name: numeral
parts_of_speech.function: Expresses number, quantity, sequence, or measure.

parts_of_speech.name: particle
parts_of_speech.function: Performs a grammatical function not covered by other closed classes.

parts_of_speech.name: pronoun
parts_of_speech.function: Points to participants or entities without repeating a full noun phrase.

parts_of_speech.name: proper_noun
parts_of_speech.function: Names a specific person, place, organization, work, or other entity.

parts_of_speech.name: punctuation
parts_of_speech.function: Delimits, groups, relates, or emphasizes written units.

parts_of_speech.name: subordinating_conjunction
parts_of_speech.function: Marks one clause as dependent on another.

parts_of_speech.name: symbol
parts_of_speech.function: Represents a non-word sign such as a currency or mathematical symbol.

parts_of_speech.name: verb
parts_of_speech.function: Predicates an event, process, action, or state.

parts_of_speech.name: other
parts_of_speech.function: Covers items whose part of speech cannot be determined or falls outside the inventory.
